label: D1 after unrewarded rare a1->S2, scaled by current a1 policy lean, weaker late in episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * choice ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO and D2). Magnitude is set almost entirely by the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) and unrewarded: that indicator alone gives dev R^2 beyond timing 0.37. Within those cells the size grows with the model policy logit at D1 (choice, more a1 = larger, weight about +0.28 per logit unit; the biggest single refinement, bringing dev to about 0.58). It also shrinks later in the episode (about -0.13 per episode decile) and is a little lower in the first decile. It is somewhat larger when the trial before was also a1 (+0.20) and smaller when that trial was rewarded (-0.24). After a rewarded a1 -> S2 trial there is only a small positive (+0.06). Every other previous-trial pattern gives about 0. A threshold on choice (ReLU) and the value head did not help. No future or hidden variables are used; choice is the model own policy output at the current step. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.57, above the profile all ceiling of 0.46 (last trial alone 0.39, policy decile 0.22).

issues: The explanation ranks the refinements in the wrong order. On dev, the a1 S2 u cell plus choice reaches only 0.42 (test 0.40, up from 0.35 for the cell alone), not the claimed 'about 0.58'. The cell plus ep_dec reaches dev 0.51 (test 0.49). So the episode-time decline is the biggest single refinement, not the policy lean.

'Weaker late' understates the time effect. Fitting the cell by decile on test gives offsets of +0.29/+0.31/+0.26/+0.18/+0.07/-0.07 for deciles 0-5 and -0.42 for deciles 6 and up, on top of a base of 0.60. Late in the episode the response nearly disappears. Decile 0 is not really lower than decile 1 (+0.29 vs +0.31); the fitted -0.12 'first decile' term is a correction to the straight-line ep_dec fit, not a real effect.

The choice slope depends on episode time, and the terms leave this out. Adding a cell*ep_dec*choice term raises test from 0.554 (cell, choice, ep_dec, a1 S2 r) to 0.594. The fitted shape is about +0.65 per logit unit early, falling by about 0.07 per decile.
The linear choice term gives impossible predictions. The activation is never negative, but the fit predicts -1.24 at D1 after an a1 S2 u trial when the agent leans to a2 (misses output, t39 window).

One error class is missed: D1 on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial falls outside the window (last_is = '?'). Several of the worst dev misses are here (actual about 1.5-1.7, predicted 0.08). They are explained by prev_reward==0 together with a positive choice: the term (phase==D1)*(prev_action==-1)*(prev_reward==0)*max(choice,0) adds about 0.065 test R^2.

Smaller claims check out. The gate is D1-only (exactly zero at GO and D2). a1 S2 r adds only about +0.06. Neither value nor a ReLU on choice adds anything when used alone. Neither since_rev nor good adds anything inside the cell. Trial t-2 being a1 (+0.18) or rewarded (-0.23) is confirmed.
skeptic.revised_label: D1 after an unrewarded rare a1->S2 trial; fades strongly over the episode (gone by trial ~60+), and is larger the more the agent leans to a1, more so early in the episode
